title: Stereotactic Body Radiation Therapy (SBRT / SABR)
description: Medicare coverage criteria for stereotactic body radiation therapy (SBRT/SABR). Requires biopsy-proven early stage Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (T1-T2N0M0) in a medically inoperable patient, or oligometastatic disease (1 to 3 active lesions) with controlled primary tumor.

criteria.name: Early-Stage NSCLC (T1-T2N0M0) or Oligometastases (<= 3 Lesions)
criteria.description: Biopsy-proven early stage lung cancer in medically inoperable patient (poor pulmonary reserve FEV1 < 40%), or oligometastatic disease with <= 3 discrete lesions.
criteria.clinical_intent: Establish tumor stage and volume qualifying for stereotactic hypofractionation

criteria.name: Rigid Immobilization and Organ Motion Management Plan
criteria.description: Treatment plan incorporating sub-millimeter stereotactic localization, custom rigid immobilization, and 4D respiratory gating/motion management.

criteria.name: Polymetastatic Disease (> 3 Lesions) Exclusion
criteria.description: Patients with diffuse polymetastatic disease (> 3 active visceral/osseous metastases) or uncontrolled primary tumor.
criteria.source_text_excerpt: Metastatic brain or spine lesions, with stable systemic disease, Karnofsky Performance Status 40 or greater (or expected to return to 70 or greater with treatment), and otherwise reasonable survival expectations, OR an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Status of 3 or less (or expected to return to 2 or less with treatment).
